conflicts.description: analytics-endpoint-fix spec sets SKIP_AUTH=true for local mode, while dashboard-login-flow-e2e-validation tests authentication flows. These are not contradictory but affect different deployment modes.
conflicts.resolution: No conflict - different deployment modes. Local mode (SKIP_AUTH=true) is for development/demo. Cloud mode (SKIP_AUTH=false) is for production with authentication. Both can coexist via environment variables.
conflicts.recommendation: Ensure dashboard-login-flow-e2e-validation tests run in cloud mode (REACT_APP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=cloud). Local mode tests should verify SKIP_AUTH works correctly.

conflicts.description: analytics-endpoint-fix queries SurrealDB directly without Redis caching. The surrealdb-primary-redis-cache spec recommends cache-aside pattern for read-heavy workloads.
conflicts.resolution: Accept direct SurrealDB queries for analytics. Trade-off: Always fresh data vs increased DB load. Analytics data changes frequently, caching would be complex with TTL/invalidation.
conflicts.recommendation: Monitor SurrealDB query load. If >10 queries/second, implement Redis caching with 30-60 second TTL. Current load (<2 queries/second) is acceptable.
